purpose: Select one finite and economically interpretable Campaign085 historical-only combination from the complete frozen 116-definition library before reading any Campaign085 source row, candidate value, comparison value, daily price, or forward return.

finite_candidate_design_catalog.reason: The fixed product of announcement-freshness rank and market-neutral late residual-drift rank is high only when a recent disclosure is accompanied by same-day idiosyncratic late-session confirmation. It combines exactly two pre-existing definitions and introduces no fitted coefficient, threshold, window, filter, subset, regime, or model.
Both standalone inputs already exist in the complete historical library and cannot be rerun as new candidates.
Opening multiple confirmation operators would create avoidable multiplicity. The sole selected operator is the exact product of the two common-universe percentile ranks.
Raw late return would reopen the terminal late-return and signed close-path families; the selected mechanism specifically requires the already frozen market-neutral residual.
Turnover/activity confirmation is already covered extensively and would reuse the prevalue-invalid Campaign079 turnover family.
Adding accounting level or acceleration would create a third component and could become a Campaign084 rescue. Campaign085 is invariant to profit, revenue, ROE, and Campaign084 values.
Hard age and sign thresholds would add two fitted or selected cutoffs. The selected product remains continuous and threshold-free.
No event-day, board, year, size, or market-regime subset is opened; every frozen eligible stock-day is evaluated under one formula.

selected_candidate.name: quarterly_freshness_market_neutral_late_drift_confirmation_product_2r
selected_candidate.economic_hypothesis: A recently disclosed quarterly report that is still followed by positive market-neutral late-session drift may reflect idiosyncratic information diffusion rather than broad-market movement; requiring both states to rank highly may identify under-reaction over the next three sessions.
selected_candidate.formula: On each exact common finite stock-day cross-section, compute average-tie percentile ranks r_freshness of quarterly_announcement_freshness_60s and r_late_residual of intraday_market_neutral_late_residual_drift_238m, then return r_freshness * r_late_residual.
selected_candidate.input_source_after_freeze: candidate-independent compact comparator cache v4 with exact frozen logical semantics
selected_candidate.cross_section_rule: Require both old-definition values finite on the exact same stock-day identity cross-section and compute pandas-compatible average-tie percentile ranks separately before multiplication.
selected_candidate.combination_rule: Exactly r_freshness * r_late_residual with two implicit unit exponents; do not rerank components on different identities and do not fit weights.
selected_candidate.missing_rule: Missing unless both frozen input values, both common-universe percentile ranks, and their product are finite. Never impute, clip, winsorize, substitute, backfill, threshold, or choose a favorable report/session.
